description:
If you found this video helpful, please subscribe. Hope you enjoy. Cheers! If you want a clean, high-end deck finish—this is the method.
In this short, I demonstrate how to build perfect picture frame borders using composite decking for seamless, professional results.

What you’ll learn:
• How to achieve perfect 45° miter cuts consistently
• Why composite decking is easier to work with than wood
• How to create tight, seamless joints using biscuit joinery
• Using adhesive to lock joints in place and keep them flat
• How to hide face screws with drilling and capping systems

Key advantage: Composite decking doesn’t expand and contract like wood—so you can build tight, precise joints without worrying about movement.

Pro tip: Combining biscuit joinery with adhesive not only strengthens the joint, it also keeps your miters perfectly aligned over time.
Perfect for DIY homeowners and anyone looking to build a premium-looking deck.
